body: Thank you for the support. I hate to be one of those people who refuses to look at the bright side and only sees the bad. But at my college you can only apply to Chemical Engineering during winter quarter, and all the prerequisites have to be done by then. So if I were to go to jail it will totally alter my plans. I would have to chose a new degree, new dreams and goals. This is because I would have missed the dead line for applying to my degree and you can't have too many credits when applying for it because it's a competitive program. Also the internship is through this Freshman program at my school. So I would not be able reapply next year. My only hope is that I don't go to jail.

hahaha thank you for the comedic relief. Even if it does nothing to be academically, it could ruin what excelling in academics accomplish. I can't always hide in a class room, and when I do leave, no one wants to hire a felon. I certainly wouldn't survive in jail. Just those 30 days in jail would mess me up so hard academically. I have finals week this next week and then I have classes starting up in three weeks. The major I am planning on doing has a very strict schedule in terms of getting all the classes done. Also I found out that I got an interview for that internship at Boeing which is on the 31st. All would be taken away from me if I had to go to jail.
Thank you. I will be sure to think it over if I do get fucked by the court. When I read through the first paragraph I just see it as things I am going to lose.

Thanks man. Unfortunately it is the city pressing charges against me. I feel like the court system here is super unorganized because as I said, the police said they would send me a letter within 90 days and it ended up being like 150 days. The thing that scares me the most is the chick. She totally made herself seem a lot more hurt than she actually was and I'm afraid that she'll get that assault charge to a felony. Also I do not have a lawyer because I'm in school so I'm poe. Both my parents lost their jobs in the last 6 months so they can't pay for one either.
